description: This file defines a class 'BuildIdFinder' that interacts with Android build artifacts, fetches build information from an internal API, compares revisions across projects, and provides functionality to identify the best matching build ID based on certain criteria. It includes methods for fetching build data, parsing XML manifests, and managing concurrent requests. The script can be executed as a standalone program, accepting optional command-line arguments to customize the build query.

classes.name: BuildIdFinder
classes.description: A class providing methods to retrieve and compare build IDs for Android project artifacts by querying an internal API and parsing XML manifests, supporting concurrent operations for efficiency.

methods.name: __init__(self, branch="aosp-master", target="aosp_cf_x86_64_phone-userdebug", batch_size=100)
methods.description: Initializes the BuildIdFinder instance by fetching local project revisions and setting target build parameters.

methods.name: __rating(self, bid, target)
methods.description: Fetches a build artifact, parses its XML manifest, and compares revisions with local project data to compute a difference score.

methods.name: batch(self, nextPageToken="", best_rating=None)
methods.description: Retrieves a batch of build IDs from the internal API, evaluates their ratings concurrently, and supports pagination and early termination based on rating thresholds.
